reviews.reason: The game with lowest attendance in May was on May 3 with 20,809 attendance against Royals. However, the statement claims 'the game with the lowest attendance... was played against the royals' - this is false because there are multiple games with the same lowest attendance (20,809) on May 3 and May 21. May 21 game was against Athletics, not Royals. Since there are multiple games tied for lowest attendance and not all are against Royals, the statement is false.
